spec.description: Returns the price levels in the order book with aggregated order quantities at each price level. The top 10 levels are returned for each trading pair.

symbol.description: A list of symbols for the currency pairs.

response.title: PreTradeBook
response.description: The top-10-level aggregated order book for a pair, plus reference/venue metadata.

symbol.description: The symbol of the currency pair.

description.description: The full description of the currency pair.

base_asset.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the base asset.

base_dti_code.description: Digital Token Identifier (DTI) code for the base asset.

base_dti_short_name.description: DTI short name for the base asset.

quote_dti_code.description: Digital Token Identifier (DTI) code for the quote asset.

quote_dti_short_name.description: DTI short name for the quote asset.

base_notation.description: Indicates how the base quantity is expressed: `UNIT` (nominal units) or `NOML` (notional value).

quote_asset.description: ISO 4217 currency in which the trading price is expressed.

quote_notation.description: Indicates that the price is expressed in monetary value.

venue.description: ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code (MIC) of the trading platform where the order was submitted.

system.description: Indicates the order system is a Central Limit Order Book.

side.description: Indicates this level is a bid.

price.description: Price level in the Central Limit Order Book (CLOB).

qty.description: The aggregated quantity at the price level.

count.description: The number of orders in the price level.

submission_ts.description: Timestamp the order at this price level was submitted.

publication_ts.description: Timestamp the price level was last updated and published.

side.description: Indicates this level is an offer.

price.description: Price level in the Central Limit Order Book (CLOB).

qty.description: The aggregated quantity at the price level.

count.description: The number of orders in the price level.

submission_ts.description: Timestamp the order at this price level was submitted.

publication_ts.description: Timestamp the price level was last updated and published.

notes: bids/asks are two distinct titled schemas (PreTradeBidLevel enum['BUY'] vs PreTradeAskLevel enum['SELL']) rather than one shared object, matching how upstream's own OpenAPI already declares them separately with different fixed `side` enums. base_asset/quote_asset dropped upstream's non-standard `format: "ISO 4217"` (not a real JSON Schema format) in favor of stating it in `description`; submission_ts/publication_ts use the real `format: "date-time"` in place of upstream's non-standard `format: "ISO 8601"`. count's upstream `minLength: 1` (invalid on an integer) was corrected to `minimum: 1`. No `pagination` block: this always returns exactly the top 10 levels per side, not a walkable collection.
